title: Senior UI Developer - eCommerce
description: Farnell Farnell, an Avnet company, is a global high-service distributor of technology products, services and solutions for electronic system design, maintenance and repair. Job Summary: We seek a Senior UI Developer to join our dynamic UI development team responsible for building and maintaining our global large-scale eCommerce platform. This role requires strong expertise in React/TypeScript, Node.js, and Apollo Client, focusing on delivering responsive, high-performance user interfaces for a seamless customer experience. As a Senior UI Developer, you will work in cross-functional team’s delivering small Agile changes to huge strategic projects. You will be supported by UX Designers, back-end developers, architects and the wider UI developer team to build scalable and visually stunning user interfaces that will power our online storefronts. Responsibilities: Lead the development of user interfaces using React and related libraries to create highly interactive, user-friendly, and visually appealing applications. Work closely with BA’s, Product Owners, UX/UI designers, and back-end engineers to transform business requirements into technical solutions, ensuring a seamless and cohesive e-commerce experience. Focus on optimizing the performance of the UI to ensure fast load times, smooth navigation, and a responsive experience across devices. This includes updating and refactoring our extensive caching solution, which is provided by Akamai at the front door, but also relies on several layers of caching technologies deeper in the application stack. Implement data fetching and state management through Apollo Client and integrate the UI with RESTful and GraphQL APIs built with Node.js and Apollo Server. Be an advocate for and follow best practices for software development, including clean, maintainable code, automated testing, and code reviews. Mentor junior and mid-level developers, offering guidance on React development, front-end architecture, and best practices. Actively engage and freely share your experience in our Front-end Guild group. Our internal community of UI Development professionals, like yourself, who want to provide the best UI outcomes, in the most modern and up to date ways. Works with back-end engineers to integrate front-end with back-end services and help shape the architecture and performance of the entire application stack. Keep up-to-date with the latest developments in front-end technologies, especially within the React ecosystem and eCommerce trends. Required Skills & Qualifications: Proven experience as a Front-End or UI Developer, with hands-on React/TypeScript experience. Ideally, you will have held a senior position previously, or you can demonstrate why you should step up to the Senior level. You will be able to demonstrate your competency in all of these technologies and tools - ReactJS, TypeScript, Node.js, Loadable Components, Jest, Styled Components, Storybook, GraphQL and Apollo (client/server) and Akamai caching (or another CDN). To stress our key needs, we will be looking for - Strong understanding of React and its ecosystem. Experience with Apollo Client and GraphQL queries, mutation handling, and state management. Solid knowledge of Node.js and how to integrate the front-end with back-end services. Expertise in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+). Experience with responsive design Experience with Gitlab and their GitFlow version control process. Ability to collaborate with UX/UI designers and translate Figma and Storybook prototypes into functional, high-quality user interfaces. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, focusing on user-centric solutions. Familiarity with front-end testing frameworks (Jest in particular). We also do A/B testing via Adobe Target. Proficient in optimizing UI performance for large-scale applications, with experience implementing lazy loading, code splitting, and other advanced optimization techniques. Familiarity with the challenges of building and scaling eCommerce platforms is a plus. Previous experience in an Agile/Scrum development environment. Development experience with Headless CMS’s solutions like Bloomreach would be beneficial. Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work in partnership and across distributed teams. We rely on frequent show and tells of working software, strong technical leadership qualities, including the ability to mentor junior developers and advocate for best practices in front-end development. Attention to detail with a passion for creating beautiful, functional, and user-centric designs. Ability to manage time and prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills.

Strong understanding of React Hooks, component composition, rendering behaviour, and frontend design patterns. Experience implementing application state management using Redux and Redux Toolkit. Hands-on experience developing real-time applications using WebSockets. Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, responsive layouts, and modern browser technologies. Experience designing reusable components and scalable frontend architectures for enterprise applications or SaaS products. Experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs and backend services. Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex issues, optimize frontend performance, and improve application reliability. Experience conducting code reviews, mentoring engineers, and contributing to technical design decisions. Core Technical Skills 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant hands-on frontend development and technical ownership. Strong expertise in React, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3. Strong understanding of React fundamentals, component lifecycle, hooks, rendering behavior, memoization, and performance optimization. Proven ability to design scalable frontend architectures, modular applications, reusable components, and maintainable UI abstractions. Strong understanding of state management, data fetching, asynchronous workflows, error handling, and application-level state synchronization. Experience implementing complex user interfaces involving dynamic forms, data grids, filtering, sorting, pagination, drag-and-drop, file handling, or real-time updates. Strong understanding of browser rendering, the DOM, event propagation, memory management, and frontend performance profiling. Experience building responsive and accessible applications in accordance with modern web accessibility standards. Experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, and backend microservices. Strong understanding of frontend security principles, including XSS prevention, secure handling of user input, and safe rendering of dynamic content. Hands-on experience with unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, including establishing effective testing strategies for complex applications. Experience with modern build tools and development workflows, such as Vite, Webpack, npm, and package management. Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and modern software delivery practices. Experience diagnosing complex production issues using browser developer tools, logs, monitoring, error tracking, and performance analysis. Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs, challenge assumptions constructively, and translate high-level architectural direction into robust frontend implementations. description: Project description The programme is building a resilient, secure, production-grade platform of Python backend services, REST APIs, asynchronous processing components and external integrations, backed by MongoDB and delivered through a React/TypeScript operational user interface with auditable operations and role-based enterprise user journeys. As a Python backend developer with MongoDB exposure, you will design and deliver well-structured, testable, asynchronous backend services and APIs for the platform, with a full-stack delivery mindset – owning features from data model through API to UI. Responsibilities Design well-structured, testable backend services and APIs with clean module boundaries and separation of concerns.
